subject.title: docs(install): recommend Node 26 as the OpenClaw runtime

question: Should OpenClaw recommend Node 26 Current for production installs before it becomes LTS and before the installer, CI, and release defaults move from Node 24?
rationale: This is a product and operational-support policy choice, not a mechanical documentation correction: it changes what new users install and what the launcher tells unsupported users to install.

options.title: Retain Node 24 as default
options.body: Keep Node 24 LTS as the recommendation and launcher hint, while documenting Node 26 as supported if desired.

options.title: Adopt Node 26 deliberately
options.body: Accept Node 26 Current as the recommended runtime after recording the support rationale and aligning or explicitly scoping installer, CI, release, and platform validation.

options.title: Defer the recommendation change
options.body: Wait until Node 26 reaches LTS, then reassess with reproducible runtime and upgrade evidence.

recommendation.title: Retain Node 24 as default
recommendation.body: Keep Node 24 LTS as the recommendation and launcher hint, while documenting Node 26 as supported if desired.
